servicesSection.title: Connect. Automate. Augment.
servicesSection.subtitle: From organized chaos to a business that runs itself.

connect.title: CONNECT — One Source of Truth
connect.description: One CRM. One source of truth. Apps that talk to each other. I clean your data, connect your tools, and build a system that reflects reality — not five spreadsheets.

automate.title: AUTOMATE — Take the Busywork Off Your Plate
automate.description: I build automations that handle email triage, follow-ups, task routing, and data entry — so your team spends time on the calls, decisions, and relationships that actually need a person.

augment.title: AUGMENT — Add Intelligence to the Mix
augment.description: With your systems connected and your processes automated, I layer in AI that handles real work. Calls answered 24/7. Client questions handled instantly. Your team's knowledge, searchable in seconds.
outcomes: Chat agent trained on your business

privacy.title: I won't tell you you're compliant.
privacy.subtitle: I show you where your data goes and give you the facts for your privacy impact assessment.
do: The text contains no health information.
A person on your team always makes the callback.
I work without access to your practice software.
Accounts are in your clinic's name, with a written exit plan.
dont: I'm not a lawyer and I don't give compliance opinions.
I don't replace your front desk with a robot.
I don't touch your clinical records.
I don't promise numbers your logs don't show.

items.question: Is a robot answering the phone?
items.answer: No. Your team answers and calls back. The system only handles the calls that slip through.

items.question: I'm already on Jane or GOrendezvous.
items.answer: Great, we start there. I look at what your plan includes and what's still turned off. I don't replace your software.

items.question: I use different software.
items.answer: The Review still works. For the next steps, I check what your software allows first and tell you honestly.

items.question: Will it work with our phone system?
items.answer: It depends on your provider and system. I check before I propose the pilot.

items.question: Will my team resist?
items.answer: The front desk is involved from the Review on. Nothing changes in their work until we've looked at it with them.

items.question: What if I want to stop?
items.answer: You can cancel the pilot anytime. Accounts are in your name and the exit plan is written.

items.question: Are you a lawyer?
items.answer: No. I document the facts. Your privacy officer or legal advisor decides.
